item.powergrid_modernized.cable_chain.to: Two metres of energy chain per link. Click the fixed anchor, then the one on the body: a 4" raceway hangs between them that you pull wire through, with a Cat6 pair built in, and it follows a moving Create Aeronautics body. String it with the trolley at the far end of its travel: pull it further than it reaches and it snaps.
item.powergrid_modernized.cable_chain_an: One end of a cable chain: a pull box with a 4" knockout, a chain post, studs L1, L2, L3 and N, and a network jack. Splice chain, conduit and studs together with an empty hand.

item.powergrid_modernized.conductor_rail: Four insulated bars on a bracket. Lay them end to end along the runway; the run is live once a Rail Feed Box is part of it.
item.powergrid_modernized.rail_feed.tool: Feeds a rail run: a pull box whose studs L1, L2, L3 and N are the four bars, with a 4" knockout and a Cat6 jack that is the run's data channel. Bars run out of both sides, so it goes anywhere in the run.
item.powergrid_modernized.rail_collector: Rides a rail on a Create Aeronautics body. Mount it one block from the rail, shoes toward the bars: while they touch a fed run its studs are the bars and its jack is on the run's data channel. Splice with an empty hand.
item.powergrid_modernized.rail_shoe.tool: Spring-loaded copper shoe for the Rail Collector.
